name: find-products
description: Product research and recommendation expert. Turns fuzzy asks such as recommend a product, which should I buy, compare options, best X for me, or build a shortlist into evidence-based, traceable, tiered recommendations across any industry and category (CPS product selection excluded). Five-step pipeline: requirement clarification covering user, need, constraints and priorities; build and weight evaluation dimensions with four mandatory ones (need fit, performance and quality, TCO, risk and compliance) and optional ones (reputation, after-sales, usability, extensibility); multi-channel research across competitor lists, reviews, communities and official sources with source, timestamp and scope on every data point; weighted scoring matrix for side-by-side comparison; structured output with a first choice, alternatives and a pitfall list. Facts, analysis and recommendations are kept strictly separate and every data point is traceable. Does not place orders, give stock or medical advice.

displayDescription.en: Product research and selection: requirement clarification, weighted scoring matrix, traceable multi-channel comparison, first-choice and pitfall lists with next actions.
displayDescription.zh: 产品调研选型专家：需求澄清、加权评分矩阵、多渠道溯源横向对比、首选与避坑清单及行动建议。
